issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota; publicly hosted by U.S. Department of Justice
title: United States v. Liban Yasin Alishire et al. — Indictment, ECF No. 1
notes: The exact original ECF No. 1 indictment is publicly hosted by DOJ and indexed as a 22-page filing in case 0:22-cr-00222, filed 2022-09-13. Direct retrieval on 2026-08-30 confirmed the attachment remains live but returned a 14,176,850-byte file that exceeded the current web parser's content-length limit. This record therefore closes document provenance/location while deliberately leaving Count 1's conspiracy statute unresolved until the pleading text can be rendered/extracted or a primary court order quotes the statute.
supports: The official DOJ attachment is the original ECF No. 1 indictment in United States v. Liban Yasin Alishire et al., No. 0:22-cr-00222-NEB-TNL.
The indexed filing is 22 pages and was filed on September 13, 2022.
does_not_support: The statute number for Count 1 conspiracy to commit wire fraud. The original pleading is located but its Count 1 text was not successfully rendered or extracted in this pass.
An inference that Count 1 must use 18 U.S.C. § 371 because neighboring Feeding Our Future indictments do; Alishire must be checked independently.
An inference that Count 1 uses 18 U.S.C. § 1349 merely because § 1349 appeared in some investigative predicates or generic descriptions of federal wire-fraud conspiracy law.
Adjudicated guilt; this is a charging instrument.
